description: This header defines interfaces and types for WebTransport protocol abstraction, including stream and session management, datagram handling, and event notification mechanisms.

classes.name: StreamVisitor
classes.description: Interface for objects that receive notifications about stream events, such as readability, resets, and state changes.

classes.name: Stream
classes.description: Represents a WebTransport stream, either bidirectional or unidirectional, with methods for reading, resetting, and managing stream state.

classes.name: SessionVisitor
classes.description: Interface for objects that receive notifications about session events, including incoming streams, session closure, and datagram reception.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Represents a WebTransport session, providing methods to accept, open, retrieve streams, send datagrams, and close the session.

methods.name: CloseSession
methods.description: Closes the WebTransport session with a specific error code and message.

methods.name: AcceptIncomingBidirectionalStream
methods.description: Returns the earliest received but unaccepted incoming bidirectional stream.

methods.name: AcceptIncomingUnidirectionalStream
methods.description: Returns the earliest received but unaccepted incoming unidirectional stream.

methods.name: CanOpenNextOutgoingBidirectionalStream
methods.description: Checks if a new outgoing bidirectional stream can be opened.

methods.name: CanOpenNextOutgoingUnidirectionalStream
methods.description: Checks if a new outgoing unidirectional stream can be opened.

methods.name: OpenOutgoingBidirectionalStream
methods.description: Opens a new outgoing bidirectional stream if flow control allows.

methods.name: OpenOutgoingUnidirectionalStream
methods.description: Opens a new outgoing unidirectional stream if flow control allows.

methods.name: GetStreamById
methods.description: Retrieves a stream by its ID.

methods.name: SendOrQueueDatagram
methods.description: Sends a datagram or queues it if unable to send immediately.

methods.name: GetMaxDatagramSize
methods.description: Returns an estimate of the maximum datagram size that can be sent.

methods.name: SetDatagramMaxTimeInQueue
methods.description: Sets the maximum time a datagram can stay in the queue before being dropped.
